summary: A school club sponsor tells the council how much the students rely on collecting cans for income.
realLife: Hickman High School's biology club sponsor described regular recycling proceeds and asked Columbia to keep the deposit while considering changes for grocers.
inGame: The catalog supports city action on bottle deposits. needs: club receipts and return value.

turns.what: The students bring their bags in before the next club meeting.
turns.pulledBy: Students can still redeem their collection.
turns.writesBack: The treasurer enters the refund in the club account.

turns.what: The sponsor calls a scrap dealer before setting a fundraising goal.
turns.writesBack: The sponsor prices the same collection as scrap before promising the next activity.
